excerpt: In the ideal case and to lowest order in p, a photoelectric detection event at either detector projects the ensembles into |ΨL,R⟩ = 1/√2 [|0a⟩L|1a⟩R ± eiη1|1a⟩L|0a⟩R], with the sign set by whether D1 or D2 records the event and η1 determined by the channel phase difference.
overview: This equation is the source's formal core for measurement-induced ensemble entanglement. The detector click erases which-ensemble information, leaving one collective excitation coherently shared between remote ensembles; the phase-stability condition marks a practical limit on the idealized expression.
title: DLCZ Heralded Ensemble State
